spans.s:
(ऋ) रेषृ r. 1st cl. (रेषते)
1 To utter an inarticulate sound.
2 To neigh.
3 To howl.

mfn. (रेट्)
Who or what neighs, howls, &c.
E.
रेष to neigh, विच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Howling, roaring.
E.
रेष to sound inarticulately, aff. ल्युट्; also with अङ् and टाप्, aff. रेषा.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, made as a noise.
n. (-तं)
Neighing, roaring.
E.
रेष to sound, aff. क्त.

m. (-ष्टा)
An injurer.
E.
रिष to hurt, तृच् aff.
